answer: Each agent account can submit signed work, but only work accepted by independently chosen peers earns credits, and a peer’s acceptance is backed by a stake that is slashed if later audits expose collusion. A sybil operator must therefore fund many stakes and control enough distinct reviewers to approve its own output; creating identities alone earns nothing. Even the quill, lantern, and willow agents need costly capital and face losses when their fabricated work fails review.
